description: Get the facts about one rikma (project): name, public description, values, links (website, GitHub, Drive, social), members, roles, open missions, missions in progress (and who holds them), open and in-progress resources, and products. Call this before planning or writing anything in a rikma - it is cheap and returns facts, unlike scanProjectDirectionsTool. For a rikma the user is not a member of, only the public face is returned (isMember:false). Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getProjectDetailsTool
name: getProjectDetailsTool
